hero.title: Everything in its place, with a name you can read
hero.description: A pocket-sized label printer that helps you sort your home, your studies and your side business in seconds — straight from your phone, with no ink.

gallery.title: Take a closer look
gallery.description: See the size of the printer, the roll inside it, and how the labels look once they are on.

how.title: How does it work?
how.description: Three steps. No computer, no learning curve.

one.title: Type your label on your phone
one.description: Open the companion app and type the name, the date or whatever detail you want to pin down.

two.title: Pick the layout that fits
two.description: Set the text size, the frame and the alignment until the label looks the way you want it.

three.title: Print, stick, and you're sorted
three.description: Hit print, press the label onto the jar or the drawer, and move on to the next one.

features.title: Small in size, big on order
features.description: Everything you need to turn clutter into labels you can read across the room.

noInk.title: Thermal printing — no ink to buy
noInk.description: It uses heat instead of ink, so there are no cartridges and no running costs after you buy it.

connection.title: Pairs easily with your phone
connection.description: It connects through the companion app for iOS and Android in a few short steps.

portable.title: Light enough to live in your bag
portable.description: Small enough to carry between home, campus and the office without thinking about it.

versatile.title: Made for home, study and small businesses
versatile.description: One simple habit that serves the kitchen, the drawer, your notes and your order packaging.

fast.title: Tidy labels in seconds
fast.description: From the thought to the label on the box: you type, you print, you're done.

width.title: Uses 15 mm label rolls
width.description: A practical width for jars, drawers, folders and cables.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Straight answers to what people ask before they buy.

ink.question: Does it need ink?
ink.answer: No. It uses thermal printing, which means the image is formed by heat on the thermal label itself, with no ink cartridges.

phone.question: Does it work with a phone?
phone.answer: Yes. It connects to a companion app for iOS and Android, and you write and print straight from your phone.

width.question: How wide are the labels?
width.answer: It uses 15 mm wide labels, a practical width for jars, drawers, folders and cables.

box.question: What comes in the box?
box.answer: We will list the box contents item by item once we have inspected the supplier's sample, so that nothing here is unconfirmed.

languages.question: Can it print in several languages?
languages.answer: The languages on this store apply to the interface only, and do not automatically mean the printer prints those scripts. We will not confirm any printing language before testing the app with a real sample, and we will update this answer once we have.

shipping.question: How do shipping and replacements work?
shipping.answer: Shipping and replacement details are published on the shipping policy and the returns and exchanges pages.

finalCta.title: Ready to make organising easy?
finalCta.description: Print your labels whenever you like, and turn clutter into order in one move.

shipping.title: Shipping policy
shipping.description: How we prepare and ship your order, and what to know before you buy.

processing.title: Order processing
processing.body: We start preparing your order once payment is confirmed, and we notify you when the parcel leaves us.

delivery.title: Delivery time
delivery.body: Delivery time is counted from the day the parcel ships and varies by destination and carrier.

coverage.title: Where we ship
coverage.body: This section will list the countries and regions we actually ship to.

costs.title: Shipping cost
costs.body: The final shipping cost is shown at checkout before you confirm your order.

tracking.title: Tracking your parcel
tracking.body: When the carrier provides a tracking number, we send it to your email address.

delays.title: Delays
delays.body: Some parcels are delayed for reasons outside our control, such as customs clearance or carrier conditions. When that happens we follow up with you until your order arrives.

returns.title: Returns and exchanges
returns.description: The terms for exchanging or returning the product after delivery.

window.title: Return window
window.body: The window for requesting an exchange or a return is counted from the day you receive your order.

condition.title: Product condition
condition.body: The product must be in its original condition with its packaging and accessories, and fit for resale.

defective.title: Damaged or incorrect items
defective.body: If your item arrives damaged or is not what you ordered, contact us with photos of the problem and we will handle it.

process.title: How to request one
process.body: Send us your order number and the reason for the exchange, then follow the instructions we send you.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.body: Refunds are issued to the original payment method after the returned product is received and inspected.

shippingCost.title: Return shipping cost
shippingCost.body: This section will state who covers return shipping in each case.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What data we collect, why we collect it, and how we handle it.

collected.title: Data we collect
collected.body: We collect the data you enter yourself when ordering or contacting us, such as your name, email address and shipping address.

usage.title: How we use your data
usage.body: We use your data to fulfil your order, reply to your messages and improve the store experience.

storage.title: Browser storage
storage.body: We store your chosen language and your cart contents in your own browser so they survive a page refresh. That data stays on your device and you can clear it from your browser settings.

sharing.title: Sharing your data
sharing.body: We do not sell your data. We share it only with the service providers needed to fulfil your order, such as the payment provider and the carrier.

analytics.title: Analytics and cookies
analytics.body: No third-party tracking tool is running on this store today. If one is added later, we will ask for your consent first and update this page.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data by contacting us.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: The rules that govern using this store and placing an order.

scope.title: Scope
scope.body: By using this store or placing an order through it, you agree to the terms set out on this page.

product.title: Product information
product.body: We work to keep the product description and photos accurate. Any specification we have not verified yet is clearly marked in the store as pending verification.

orders.title: Orders and prices
orders.body: The prices shown apply at the moment you place your order. We reserve the right to correct an obvious pricing or description error before shipping, in which case we notify you and let you cancel.

payment.title: Payment
payment.body: Payment is processed by our payment provider. We do not store your card details on our servers.

liability.title: Limits of liability
liability.body: The product is intended for ordinary home and office use. We are not liable for damage caused by use that goes against the manufacturer's instructions.

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.body: The store's text and design belong to Rattebha. The product name and model belong to the manufacturer.
